description: Upgrade your outdoor adventures with Rothco's Lightweight MOLLE Bottle Carrier. Weighing 3 ounces, this carrier is designed to securely hold most water bottles, ensuring you stay hydrated on the go. The carrier’s versatile design features a 6 inch MOLLE strap and 4.2 inch x 1 inch MOLLE loops on the backside, allowing for easy attachment to your backpack, belt, or tactical gear. The carrier boasts a rugged and lightweight design, complemented by an elastic cord that provides a secure grip on your bottle during movement. For added security, the carrier includes 6.5 inch hook & loop closures and 2 webbing straps, ensuring your bottle stays in place even during rigorous activities. Perfect for camping, fishing, hiking, or any outdoor excursion, this carrier offers convenience and functionality wherever you go. With a generous 16 inch wingspan on the webbing straps, it accommodates most standard water bottles, making the bottle carrier a versatile accessory for outdoor enthusiasts. Measuring at 2 inch x 13 inch, this carrier is compact yet efficient, providing ample space for your bottle without adding unnecessary bulk to your gear. Please note that the bottle is not included with the carrier. Enhance your outdoor experience with Rothco's Lightweight MOLLE Bottle Carrier, the perfect companion for staying hydrated during your adventures.
